sentences.en: The EC's Twelve are working out a compromise on farm-price.
sentences.zh: 欧盟的十二国正在就农产品价格达成妥协。

sentences.en: I could swim across the river when I was twelve.
sentences.zh: 我十二岁的时候可以游过那条河。

sentences.en: My twelve year old boy doesn't like to play baseball.
sentences.zh: 我的十二岁的儿子不喜欢打棒球。
